title: Jasper's Create Pack
description: A collection of create addons focused on improving the automation and construction experience.
body:
> **Why would you want to download this modpack?** Jasper's Create Pack centers around Create, a mod allowing easy automation and control of so many elements of Minecraft. The modpack expands upon the core Create experience with a variety of carefully chosen additions, enabling players to automate complex processes, and explore new possibilities for building and resource management. If you've played the Create mod and still want more, Jasper's Create Pack is designed for you. > **What does this modpack add?** Jasper's Create Pack expands the Create mod with new food, easier automation, decorative options, oil extraction, live train maps, and more.
